limits: Records are self-reported. Structural validation cannot authenticate evidence or certify taste/security.

decide.description: Current state and a smaller option are considered

feature-plan.description: Main and relevant failure/recovery paths are explicit
Business rules and permission boundaries are testable
In-scope, exclusions and open decisions are clear

impact-map.description: Adjacent workflows have a risk-weighted check matrix
Actual changes and unmapped areas are reviewed

build-fix.description: Reproduction and expected outcome are recorded
Changes and test/config edits are reviewed
Original failure and relevant neighbors were exercised

verify-release.description: Acceptance criteria map to actual evidence
Changed or skipped tests/configuration are disclosed
Implemented, tested and deployed states are distinct

security-review.description: Assets, entry points and trust boundaries are identified
Relevant deny paths and adversarial inputs are checked
Findings and untested areas have evidence and remediation

ui-polish.description: Task hierarchy, typography and density fit real content
Primary flow, states and responsive behavior are checked
Implementation matches the selected project surface

customer-care.description: Actual impact and expected behavior are captured
State, owner and next update are actionable
Reply matches evidence and exposes no private diagnostics

growth.description: Chosen action addresses a documented or labeled assumed bottleneck
Hypothesis, audience, action and measurement are explicit

sales.description: Prospect need and fit are evidenced or unknown
Capabilities and commercial terms match approved records
Draft/approved/sent/replied states and recipient are accurate

content-studio.description: One defensible idea is clear at viewing size
Composition adds meaning and fits the brand
Required actual visual/temporal checks have evidence

founder-brief.description: Source dates, timezone and gaps are explicit
A short ranked set has rationale and next actions
No invented automation, account access or completed work
